expected_title: The Sentinels LEOP Experience: Putting in Orbit the Copernicus Constellation
abstract: This paper describe s the assumptions and concepts that were considered within the Flight Operations Segment when defining the different requirements, limitations and constraints linked to the LEOP operations of the Sentinels. The paper present s how the selected concept and infrastructure allowed for a smooth LEOP FOS design where new Sentinels missions could prepare their LEOP operations re - using the av ailable components, reducing testing, integration and validation time, in parallel to executing their nominal operations. The resulting LEOP Operational Concept applied across the Sentinels’ is summarized, including the as - executed LEOP results, highlighti ng the lessons learnt , achieved efficiencies/cost reductions, and the evolutions for the upcoming Sentinels .
